claim: Trooping the Colour 2026 (King's Birthday Parade) is Saturday 13 June, with the parade starting 10:30am at Horse Guards and an RAF flypast at 1:00pm.
quote: The King's Company, 1st Battalion Grenadier Guards will Troop their Colour in the presence of His Majesty The King on Saturday 13th June 2026... parade begins at Horse Guards Parade at 10.30am

claim: Free public viewing of Trooping the Colour is from The Mall or the edge of St James's Park from 9am; seated stand tickets are by ballot.
quote: a limited view can be obtained by standing on The Mall or on the edge of St James's Park overlooking Horse Guards Parade from 9.00am

claim: RHS Chelsea Flower Show 2026 runs 19-23 May at the Royal Hospital Chelsea and will already be over by the 29 May trip-start date.
quote: RHS Chelsea Flower Show 2026 will be held from 19-23 May 2026 at the Royal Hospital Chelsea

claim: Wimbledon Championships 2026 run Monday 29 June to Sunday 12 July at the All England Club in SW19, with the final weekend just outside the trip window.
quote: Wimbledon 2026 will take place from Monday, June 29 to Sunday, July 12

claim: The Wimbledon public ballot for 2026 closed in September 2025, but ~500 show-court tickets per day are released to The Queue (arrive 24h ahead for show courts, 5-6am for Grounds Pass).
quote: The public ballot for 2026 closed in September 2025. Only around one in 10 applicants receive Wimbledon tickets 2026 through the public ballot.

claim: The Royal Academy Summer Exhibition 2026 opens to the public on 16 June and runs to 23 August, coordinated by Ryan Gander RA on the theme 'Interconnectedness'.
quote: The Summer Exhibition 2026 runs from 16 June to 23 August

claim: Taste of London takes over Regent's Park from Wednesday 17 to Sunday 21 June 2026 with 30+ restaurants across afternoon and evening sessions.
quote: Taste of London 2026 takes place from Wednesday 17 June to Sunday 21 June 2026 at The Regent's Park

claim: London Open Gardens 2026 falls on Saturday 6 and Sunday 7 June, unlocking 120+ private and gated gardens across 12 boroughs for £5 entry.
quote: 120+ green spaces that are typically off-limits to the hoi polloi swing open their gates for London Open Gardens... Saturday 6 and Sunday 7 June 2026

claim: Pride in London 2026 is Saturday 4 July, with the parade stepping off at noon from Hyde Park Corner through Piccadilly and Regent Street to Whitehall — just outside the late-June window.
quote: Pride in London 2026 takes place on Saturday, July 4, 2026. The parade steps off at noon

claim: Greenwich+Docklands International Festival has moved its 2026 edition to 22 August – 6 September, so it is not part of the May/June trip window.
quote: The 2026 festival is scheduled to run from 22nd August – 6th September

claim: June 2026 highlights also include the second Lido Festival in Victoria Park, SXSW London, West End LIVE in Trafalgar Square (17-26 June, free musical sing-alongs), Battersea Jazz Festival, and major Anish Kapoor / Frida Kahlo exhibitions.
quote: West End LIVE takes place 17-26 Jun, where theatre fans head to Trafalgar Square for sing-alongs to favourite musicals

claim: BST Hyde Park returns for a 13th edition with Lewis Capaldi, Pitbull and Garth Brooks across June-July weekends, and the free Great Exhibition Road Festival of science and arts takes place 6-7 June 2026.
quote: BST will be back again for its 13th edition... Lewis Capaldi, Pitbull and Garth Brooks already announced as headliners for 2026... The Great Exhibition Road Festival is a free annual celebration of science and the arts on 6-7 June 2026

claim: Speakers' Corner at the NE edge of Hyde Park hosts open-air public oratory every Sunday since 1866, with crowds typically gathering around noon — free and continuous.
quote: Every Sunday since 1866 a range of different speakers gather at Speaker's Corner to air their views

claim: Uber Boat by Thames Clippers runs river-bus services Putney to Barking Riverside seven days a week, with a hop-on hop-off River Roamer day pass passing Big Ben, Tate Modern, the Shard and Tower Bridge.
quote: Hop-on Hop-off ticket is an unlimited all-day ticket to travel across all piers between Putney and Barking Riverside

claim: Top Sunday roast bookings in London include The Harwood Arms (the only Michelin-starred pub, releases tables 90 days ahead), The Marksman in Hackney, Blacklock, Quality Chop House, and The Red Lion & Sun — all need booking weeks ahead.
quote: The Harwood Arms in Fulham is London's only Michelin-starred pub... Bookings release 90 days in advance and disappear quickly

claim: Free outdoor cinema in the window includes Summer Screens at Canary Wharf (4 June-1 Sep, films/Wimbledon/cricket on Canada Square Park's big screen) and Lower Marsh Lates (Cool Runnings 25 June, free entry).
quote: Free screenings run from 4 June-1 September 2026... Summer Screens at Canary Wharf... coverage of Wimbledon and cricket fixtures

claim: London's free Royal Parks — Hyde Park, Regent's Park (with Queen Mary's Rose Gardens at peak in June), Greenwich Park (Royal Observatory and skyline view), Richmond Park (deer), and St James's Park — are all open and ideal for sunny-day picnics.
quote: London's best parks include Hyde Park, Regent's Park, Hampstead Heath, Greenwich Park, Richmond Park, and Victoria Park — all free to enter

claim: The Spring Bank Holiday Monday is 25 May 2026, falling immediately before the trip start; carry-over openings into 29 May include Somerset House's 'Holy Pop!' exhibition and London Rivers Week's 10th anniversary programme.
quote: Somerset House's "Holy Pop!" exhibition explores the power of fandom through art, memorabilia, letters, photographs, and interactive installations
